title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.157 QA: removes the oversized GENESYS FANTASY brand block from the Character Sheet header, moves the portrait to the left, expands character identity space, and adds a compact right-side resource panel for XP Available, XP Earned, Funds, and Configure. Adds Actor data fields for starting/earned/spent XP and setting-friendly currency while keeping automatic XP spending for the upcoming advancement step. Characteristics and Health & Defense remain on separate full-width rows. Preserves Biography-first layout, streamlined Initiative, five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
